CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cpn_my_entrepreneur()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT id FROM entrepreneurs WHERE user_id = auth.uid() ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.driver_company_active(c uuid, u uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsc_drivers d JOIN jsc_company_members m ON m.company_id=d.company_id AND m.user_id=d.user_id WHERE d.company_id=c AND d.user_id=u AND d.is_active AND d.archived_at IS NULL AND m.is_active AND m.archived_at IS NULL AND m.role='chauffeur');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.driver_identity_current(c uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsc_drivers WHERE company_id=c AND user_id=auth.uid()) OR public.driver_company_active(c);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.driver_mission_access(mid uuid, writing boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM drv_missions m JOIN transport_requests t ON t.id=m.requisition_id WHERE m.id=mid AND m.company_id=t.requisition_company_id AND m.user_id=auth.uid() AND driver_company_active(m.company_id) AND requisition_access(t)='driver' AND (NOT writing OR (m.ended_at IS NULL AND t.requisition_state IN ('accepted','running'))));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.driver_user_current()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsc_drivers WHERE user_id=auth.uid())
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsc_drivers d WHERE d.user_id=auth.uid() AND public.driver_company_active(d.company_id))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsc_company_members m WHERE m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.is_active AND m.archived_at IS NULL AND m.role<>'chauffeur');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.entcrm_can_admin(_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT coalesce(public.entcrm_role(_company_id) IN ('support','proprietaire'), false) $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.entcrm_can_read(_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ SELECT public.entcrm_role(_company_id) IS NOT NULL $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fleet_member_role(_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT m.role
  FROM public.jsc_company_members m
  WHERE m.company_id = _company_id
    AND m.user_id = auth.uid()
    AND m.is_active = true
    AND m.archived_at IS NULL
  LIMIT 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = _user_id AND role = _role AND approved = true
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jsc_my_driver_ids()
 RETURNS SETOF uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT d.id FROM public.jsc_drivers d
 JOIN public.jsc_company_members m ON m.company_id=d.company_id AND m.user_id=d.user_id
 WHERE d.user_id=auth.uid() AND d.is_active AND d.archived_at IS NULL
   AND m.is_active AND m.archived_at IS NULL AND m.role='chauffeur';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.requisition_access(t transport_requests)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN public.workbench_manager(t.requisition_company_id) THEN 'manager' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.jsc_drivers d JOIN public.jsc_company_members m ON m.company_id=d.company_id AND m.user_id=d.user_id WHERE d.id=t.requisition_driver_id AND d.company_id=t.requisition_company_id AND d.user_id=auth.uid() AND d.is_active AND d.archived_at IS NULL AND m.is_active AND m.archived_at IS NULL AND m.role='chauffeur') THEN 'driver' END
$function$
